seoTitle: Rocket Appartamento vs Mozzafiato: Which to Buy (UK)
title: Rocket Espresso Appartamento vs Mozzafiato: which to buy in the UK
description: Rocket Appartamento, Appartamento TCA or Mozzafiato FAST? UK prices checked today, the real differences and which one suits you.
intro:
**For most home baristas, the Rocket Appartamento TCA at £1,450 is the one to buy: it adds adjustable temperature to Rocket's compact classic for £100 more than the basic Appartamento.** Step up to the Mozzafiato FAST only if you want a display, finer temperature control and, on the R model, a quieter rotary pump that can be plumbed in. The cheapest Mozzafiato today is the V FAST at £1,665 at Bella Barista, £135 under Rocket's own price.

We checked every price below on 10 November 2026. Rocket Espresso UK wasn't running any discounts on new machines that day, but its machine and grinder bundles save £55 on buying the two separately, and it offers 0% finance.

deals.name: Rocket Espresso Appartamento TCA (Steel/White, Steel/Black or Steel/Copper)

deals.note: The cheapest way into a Rocket. It has no temperature adjustment, so you manage brew temperature with a short flush before each shot. Fine if you mainly make milky drinks. The Black/White version is £1,390.

deals.name: Rocket Espresso Mozzafiato V FAST, Black
deals.note: Bella Barista's 10% flash sale makes this the cheapest Mozzafiato we found, £135 under Rocket UK's £1,800 pre-order price. It's the vibration-pump version: PID control and a display, but no plumb-in option. Bella Barista gives a two-year back-to-base warranty.

deals.name: Rocket Espresso Mozzafiato R FAST, Chrome
deals.note: The R adds a rotary pump, which is quieter and can run from the mains water supply. Espresso Coffee Shop charges the same, and Coffee Friend is dearer at £2,190. Rocket UK had only three left on 10 November.

deals.name: Rocket Espresso Appartamento 2.0 White + Faustino grinder bundle
deals.note: £55 less than buying the machine (£1,350) and Faustino grinder (£540) separately. You need a good grinder for espresso, so a bundle is worth considering if you don't have one.

deals.note: The TCA with Rocket's Giannino grinder, £55 less than the two bought separately (£1,450 plus £625). The black and copper TCA versions cost £2,055 in the bundle.

body:
## Appartamento vs Mozzafiato: the short version

Both are heat-exchanger machines with a 1.8-litre copper boiler and the classic E61 group head, so both let you brew espresso and steam milk at the same time. The differences are in control, size and noise.

- **Appartamento 2.0 (£1,350):** compact, vibration pump, 2.5-litre water tank, no temperature adjustment. It's 27cm wide, so it fits under most kitchen cupboards.
- **Appartamento TCA (£1,450):** the same size, plus Temperature Control Adjustment. You change the setting with the steam lever rather than a screen, and reviewers count three or four presets. It also adds an insulated boiler, a low-water sensor, auto standby and a wider drip tray.
- **Mozzafiato V FAST (£1,800 at Rocket, £1,665 at Bella Barista):** PID temperature control with an OLED display, a dual pressure gauge and extra heaters in the group head for a faster warm-up. Vibration pump, smaller 1.8-litre tank.
- **Mozzafiato R FAST (£1,950):** as the V, but with a rotary pump. That makes it quieter, and it can be plumbed in to your water supply.

The Giotto FAST costs the same as the Mozzafiato and is essentially the same machine with a different body, so pick on looks.

## Which should you buy?

**Buy the Appartamento TCA if** you want a proper espresso machine that looks good and doesn't take over the worktop. The temperature presets fix the main weakness of the original Appartamento, which needs a cooling flush before each shot to avoid bitter espresso. Reviewers find only two of the settings really useful, but that's enough for light and dark roasts.

**Buy the basic Appartamento 2.0 if** you mostly make lattes and flat whites. Milk hides small temperature swings, and you save £100.

**Buy the Mozzafiato FAST if** you've used a home espresso machine before and want more control. The display lets you set an exact temperature, and the twin gauge shows brew and boiler pressure. Choose the R if you can plumb it in or hate pump noise; otherwise the V is better value, especially at today's Bella Barista price. Reviews also note it is heavy (27–30kg) and deep, about 57cm with the handle fitted, so measure your worktop first.

## Warm-up time and running costs

Heat exchangers take a while to warm up. Reviewers say the original Appartamento needs about 20 minutes. Rocket says the FAST models heat up faster; one US review measured about 12 minutes, while a German test found 25 minutes as delivered, dropping to about 15 after changing a hidden setting. A smart plug that switches the machine on before you get up solves this for any of them.

## Don't forget the grinder

A Rocket needs freshly ground beans and a grinder made for espresso. Rocket's cheapest, the Faustino, is £540, and the Giannino is £625. The bundles above save £55. If you already own a good espresso grinder, buy the machine alone.

## Warranty and where to buy

Rocket Espresso UK is the official UK distributor. Its warranty is two years on parts and one year on labour for home users, provided you follow the maintenance guidance. It also offers 0% finance. Bella Barista gives two years back-to-base. Whichever you choose, descaling and regular backflushing keep these machines running for decades.

## Will Rocket machines be cheaper on Black Friday?

Rocket UK had no discounts on new machines on 10 November, and prosumer espresso brands rarely cut prices by much. Specialist retailers sometimes run short flash sales instead, like Bella Barista's 10% off the Mozzafiato V. We'll update this page if Rocket announces a Black Friday offer. For cheaper machines from Sage, De'Longhi and Ninja, see our [coffee machine Black Friday deals guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/), and the [Black Friday 2026 hub](/black-friday/) for every other brand.

### Is the Rocket Appartamento TCA worth the extra £100?

For most people, yes. Being able to adjust brew temperature makes espresso more consistent and saves flushing water through before each shot.

### Can you plumb in a Rocket Appartamento?

No. The Appartamento and TCA run from their 2.5-litre tank only. Of the Mozzafiato models, only the R FAST can be plumbed in.

### What's the difference between Mozzafiato R and V?

The R has a rotary pump, which is quieter and allows plumbing in. The V has a vibration pump and costs £150 less at Rocket UK.

### Is Rocket Espresso a good brand?

Rocket machines are hand-built in Milan with commercial-style parts, and reviewers consistently praise the build quality and steam power. They're for people who enjoy making coffee by hand, not for push-button convenience.
